scenes.description: Frame 0: Rivaldo holding the Ballon d'Or (#1), full colour; colour drains to B&W on «انهارت»; cut to Van Gaal on the touchline (#2), then Rivaldo on the bench (#3)
scenes.shot_intent: Hook: the trophy and the bench in one breath, so the paradox is the first thing seen
scenes.information_role: The best player in Europe was benched the same day he was crowned

scenes.description: Time rewinds: year counter spins 1999 → 1980s over the drained trophy photo, which recedes into darkness; reverse-whoosh
scenes.shot_intent: Bridge from the hook to the origin story without a hard cut
scenes.information_role: We are going back before Barcelona
scenes.overlay_notes: DM Mono year counter, chapter marker I THE HUNGER fades in

scenes.description: Recife neighbourhood photo (#4), near B&W with heavy dust; slow pan; km counter 0→15 on «بيمشي مسافات طويلة»; cut to early-career portrait (#5)
scenes.shot_intent: Make poverty concrete: place, distance, body
scenes.information_role: He was malnourished and walked kilometres to train

scenes.description: Close portrait (#6); name reveal letter by letter in Archivo Black with 0.045 s stagger on «ريفالدو فيتور بوربا فيريرا»
scenes.shot_intent: Name the subject only after the hook and the hardship
scenes.information_role: His full name

scenes.description: D3 map of Brazil, stone400 map dots; gold dot lands on Recife; serif-italic «1972»
scenes.shot_intent: Geography and year in one frame
scenes.information_role: Born 1972 in Recife, north-east Brazil

scenes.description: Father's photo (#8) or a silhouette frame if none; three soft beats on «بيشجعه / بيتابعه / بيحلم معاه»
scenes.shot_intent: Give the father a face so his loss lands
scenes.information_role: His father believed in him

scenes.description: Black frame; «1989» in Instrument Serif, alone; the bed drops to silence (+0.6 s) before «والد ريفالدو مات»
scenes.shot_intent: Silence before the impact; loss shown by absence
scenes.information_role: His father died in 1989; he wanted to quit

scenes.description: Early photo (#5) re-graded warmer; slow push
scenes.shot_intent: The mother's refusal turns the story
scenes.information_role: His mother told him to keep going

scenes.description: Four club photos (#10) slide in one per club name (Santa Cruz, Mogi Mirim, Corinthians, Palmeiras); type-only club names, no modern crests
scenes.shot_intent: Show the climb as a fast staircase
scenes.information_role: Four Brazilian clubs in a few years

scenes.description: Deportivo photo (#11); DM Mono «LA CORUÑA · 1996-97»
scenes.shot_intent: Europe notices him
scenes.information_role: One season at Deportivo was enough

scenes.description: Ronaldo at Barça/Inter (#12) slides out; Rivaldo's presentation (#13) lands on «ريفالدو»; first blaugrana stripes
scenes.shot_intent: Replacement narrative: one Brazilian leaves, another arrives
scenes.information_role: Barça bought him after losing Ronaldo
scenes.overlay_notes: chapter marker III BARCELONA; Barça value 0.35→0.8

scenes.description: Celebration photo (#14) with two trophy glyphs landing on «مرتين» and «مرة» inside a small morph plate
scenes.shot_intent: Quantify the first two seasons
scenes.information_role: Two league titles and one Copa del Rey

scenes.description: Plate morphs to a date card: serif italic «December 1999» (date disputed, see F10), label BALLON D'OR
scenes.shot_intent: Set the clock for the coronation
scenes.information_role: The Ballon d'Or announcement
scenes.overlay_notes: chapter marker IV THE BALLON D'OR

scenes.description: Beckham in Man United kit (#15), cool grade; DM Mono «MANCHESTER UNITED · 1998-99 · TREBLE»
scenes.shot_intent: Establish the rival so the number means something
scenes.information_role: Beckham had won the treble

scenes.description: GOLD CLIMAX: dark plate (frame A); silence +0.8 s; 154 counts up (white), 219 counts up (gold), one crisp integer per frame; plate dissolves into the darkroom reveal of #1, highlights first, one continuous pull-back
scenes.shot_intent: The slowest move in the film; the number, then the image
scenes.information_role: Rivaldo 219 vs Beckham 154: Ballon d'Or

scenes.description: FIFA award photo (#17); then split frame: child photo (#5) ↔ trophy photo (#1)
scenes.shot_intent: Callback to the hook: the child who walked became the best
scenes.information_role: He also won FIFA World Player 1999
scenes.overlay_notes: gold pen ring around the face on #1

scenes.description: «صح؟» then a dip to black for 0.8 s, «لأ.» on black, sub-hit
scenes.shot_intent: Pattern interrupt; the gold drains
scenes.information_role: The happiest moment was not happy

scenes.description: Tactics board (chalk, char600→ink): a dot on the left wing, an arrow to the No.10 zone on «العمق»; Van Gaal photo (#18) cold; bench photo (#3) on «استبعد»
scenes.shot_intent: Explain the dispute visually, not with words on screen
scenes.information_role: Van Gaal wanted him on the left; he wanted the centre; he was dropped

scenes.description: Date card «17 June 2001» over faint stripes (frame B layout); morph plate shows stakes: WIN = UCL / DRAW = VALENCIA
scenes.shot_intent: Set the stakes before the match
scenes.information_role: Barça must win the last game

scenes.description: Split-flap scoreboard BAR–VAL flips on each spoken score (1-0, 1-1, 2-1, 2-2), match stills (#19) behind at 30 %; «خارج» = plate turns stampInk
scenes.shot_intent: Let the score carry the tension, one flip per word
scenes.information_role: Rivaldo scores twice; Valencia equalise twice

scenes.description: ACTION PEAK: minute clock 87; stills of the chest control, ball in the air, the overhead kick; freeze + silence (+0.9 s) before «مقصية»; white flash 0.55 + shake on «جول»; crowd swell (+1.5 s); flap to 3-2
scenes.shot_intent: The fastest cutting in the film, then a held freeze
scenes.information_role: The 87th-minute bicycle kick: 3-2, hat-trick, Champions League

scenes.description: Camp Nou celebration (#20) wide, slow pull-back
scenes.shot_intent: Release after the peak
scenes.information_role: One of the most famous goals in club history

scenes.description: Yokohama final (#21), Rivaldo in yellow No. 10 holding the trophy; Brazil 3-band bar at the top edge
scenes.shot_intent: The last chapter is with Brazil, not Barça
scenes.information_role: World Cup winner 2002, Brazil 2-0 Germany
scenes.overlay_notes: chapter marker VII YOKOHAMA ’02; Barça value 0

scenes.description: Van Gaal's 2002 return photo (#22), cold; Rivaldo (#23) darkens as he leaves the frame
scenes.shot_intent: The story closes on the same conflict it opened with
scenes.information_role: Van Gaal came back, Rivaldo left

scenes.description: Recap montage, one photo per clause: child (#5) → Ballon d'Or (#1) → overhead kick (#19) → World Cup (#21), warming grade
scenes.shot_intent: Full-arc callback before the title
scenes.information_role: From poverty to the Ballon d'Or and the World Cup

scenes.description: Best Barça portrait (#23); pause +0.7 s; name title in gold metal
scenes.shot_intent: Name the legend as the final image
scenes.information_role: His story
scenes.overlay_notes: title in Archivo Black + Noto Kufi

scenes.description: Teaser: Ronaldinho at his 2003 presentation (#24); «الحلقة 3» card
scenes.shot_intent: Open the next curiosity gap
scenes.information_role: Next episode: Ronaldinho

scenes.description: End card: page badge 190 px, VIVA BARÇA in gold (clip reveal + one sheen), blue/garnet split rule, BARCELONA ARMY EGYPT
scenes.shot_intent: Series signature
scenes.information_role: Barcelona Army Egypt sign-off
